label: late original phase / <DEL> in b-heavy sequences (input b or sequence starts with b)
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.03% of steps). It fires only late in the original phase (t=5..9, mostly orig_idx 6-7) or on the <DEL> step, and never in the copy phase. Within that window it is tied to token b: 53% of mass is on steps where the input is b, and 70% is in sequences whose first token is b. The strongest activations are an input b at t~6 in a sequence that also starts with b, after digit-poor runs of letters like e/v/d/x/c/s (top: b n s d v e [b]). Sequences containing digits weaken it. The window+b predicate captures ~94% of mass but has only ~3% precision. Most b-start or b-input late steps do not fire, so it depends on further hidden-state context that no simple predicate captured. The best precise subset (input b, first token b, t>=5) has precision 0.36 and recall 0.16.
